what: SessionStart no-spawn regression is not observable
scenario_or_breakage: A failing python3 stub with no claude-implement-* dirs can still be invoked and then swallowed by the required fail-open path, yielding the same exit 0 and empty stdout as a skipped spawn; this leaves the explicit no steady-state Python spawn requirement unverifiable
suggested_fix: Make the stub write a marker or counter before exiting and assert that marker is absent when no session dirs exist, or add an equivalent structural check for SessionStart pre-check before the Python call
